description: In server.rs jmap_api_handler, user_id is resolved by a SELECT from the users table at the start of the request. For a new user who has just been provisioned, this lookup may return None and fall back to SINGLETON_USER_ID=1. If the user later appears in the database (e.g. via concurrent provisioning), subsequent calls in the same request batch still use user_id=1, but the new user's data may have been written under their actual user_id. In a multi-user deployment this means the first request after account creation reads and writes state under user_id=1 rather than the correct user_id.
notes: v1 is single-user by design; SINGLETON_USER_ID fallback is intentional. Warning log already added. Multi-user provisioning race is a v2 concern.
title: jmap_api_handler: user_id lookup races with per-method state reads
